profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Magic Leap

positions.title: Programming Development Director
positions.description:
* Created the Goo feature for the Grey Goo game. These were procedurally created amoebas that would roam the map.
* Managed a team of programmers to create Real Time Strategy Games.
* Game Engine work including collision detection, movement, navigation,  components, many other systems.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
* Developed AI, navigation, movement for non-player characters. 
* General game features.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
* Managed a team of six programmers.
* Directed the development of game features.
* Developed data driven component system.
* General feature development.
* Created many of the AI systems of the game.
